questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: 'He said that he [finish] the report by Friday.'
Select the correct reported speech form: 'She said, 'I am going to the cinema tomorrow.''
options: She said that she was going to the cinema that day.
She said that she is going to the cinema that day.
She said that she goes to the cinema that day.
She said that she will go to the cinema that day.
questions.answer: She said that she was going to the cinema that day.
